items.title: France intercepts suspected Russia-linked oil tanker off the coast of Sicily
items.description: French maritime authorities said the vessel, the fifth alleged Russian vessel France has boarded, was flying a false flag. 'We will not allow the 'shadow fleet' to circumvent sanctions and finance Russia's war effort,' said Emmanuel Macron.

items.title: In High-Stakes Bluff, Putin Holds a Losing Hand
items.description: Ukraine’s recent battlefield successes do not bode well for the Kremlin leader. Thanks to Europe’s steady financial and military support for Kyiv, Russia is experiencing casualties unprecedented since World War II. Meanwhile, the US waivers in its historic transatlantic commitment.

items.title: Israel continues to commit genocide, atrocity crimes by deliberately targeting Palestinian children, UN independent commission finds
items.description: Israeli authorities and security forces have deliberately targeted Palestinian children, resulting in genocide and atrocity crimes in the Gaza Strip and war crimes in the West Bank, a UN independent commission of inquiry said in its latest report released on Tuesday.
